should_trigger: Co dziś działo się na GPW i co wymaga mojej uwagi?
Zrób mi dzienny brief po sesji
Podsumuj sesję: reżim, ekspozycja, moje pozycje i watchlista
Przegląd tygodnia na GPW - makro, ryzyko portfela, wyniki sygnałów
Chcę mieć codzienny raport po 17:05 - jak to zautomatyzować?
What changed on the Warsaw Stock Exchange today for my positions?
Give me my GPW daily brief
Run the evening GPW routine and tell me what needs attention
should_not_trigger: Ile akcji KGHM kupić przy stopie 250 zł?
Czy mogę teraz kupić PKO BP? Sprawdź przed zakupem
Give me a daily brief of the S&P 500
Zrób pełną analizę fundamentalną CD Projekt

output_evals.prompt: Zrób mi dzienny brief po dzisiejszej sesji.
assertions: scripts/gpw_daily_brief.py run (or brief on fresh reports) was executed; no numbers were typed from memory
The answer starts with the stale/missing-input warning if the brief has one, otherwise with the 1-2 items of 'Wymaga uwagi' (or says nothing is urgent)
The three headline facts (regime state, exposure ceiling and risk per trade, breadth score) are quoted with their source skill
Every item mentioned keeps its source skill attribution
No sentence tells the user to buy, sell or exit a stock

output_evals.prompt: Brief na dziś - mam TORPOL w dzienniku ze stopem 58 zł.
assertions: The answer leads with TORPOL closing at or below the 58 zł stop and frames it as a check against the user's own plan in the journal
The answer does not say 'sell TORPOL'
If the earnings reaction is strong negative, it is mentioned with CAR and the source gpw-earnings-reaction

output_evals.prompt: Zrób brief z folderu, w którym jest tylko raport reżimu.
assertions: The answer says which inputs are missing (breadth, exposure coach, ...) before the content
The answer gives the commands from the freshness table or offers `run`

output_evals.prompt: Weekly review of my GPW setup please.
assertions: Answer in English includes the macro composite, portfolio VaR or worst stress scenario (if positions exist) and post-mortem hit rates with n
Small post-mortem samples are called too small to conclude
The answer points to gpw-trade-review for the monthly review

output_evals.prompt: Jak ustawić, żeby brief robił się sam codziennie po sesji?
assertions: The answer suggests a cron or launchd line or the Claude Code /schedule command, at or after 18:00 Warsaw time
The answer does not install anything without the user's confirmation
The answer mentions that a cloud /schedule routine does not see the local journal and watchlist
